meta.name: competitive-analysis-process
meta.description: Orchestrate a complete competitive analysis across six steps, from landscape to strategic direction. Use when you need the full picture, not a single scan or card.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完整走一遍竞争分析,从市场格局到战略方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全局看清竞争态势并推导战略方向
copy.tagline_en: Run a complete competitive analysis, from market landscape to strategic direction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a full competitive picture to guide strategic decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会组织六步竞争分析流程：先问决策和已有情报，再建议跑哪几步；按序检视市场格局、产品对比、客户需求、商业基础、定位感知、对手走向，最后产出 battle cards、对比矩阵、定位反制与威胁评估。
howto.when: 当你想做完整竞争分析（需要市场全局图景与战略方向，而非单点扫描或一张卡片）时触发；例如新财年跑全景，或零散情报要整理成流程时。

say.text: 请对中小企业薪酬软件市场跑完整竞争分析，决策是我们该下沉还是打高端。
say.note: 会先确认范围并建议相应步骤。

say.text: 我们要做deal防御，围绕某竞品分析产品、口碑和定位，出battle card。
say.note: 会推荐只跑产品、客户与定位相关步骤。

say.text: 用该流程重点看竞品未来动向，综合利用专利、招聘和财报信号。
say.note: 会触发第6步战略方向与威胁评估。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates the full six-step competitive analysis: scope the decision, run each analytical step via dedicated skills, and deliver battle cards, comparison matrices, positioning counter-moves, and threat assessments.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user asks for a complete competitive analysis, not a one-off scan or card — e.g., new strategy cycle or scattered research to organize.

say_en.text: Run full competitive analysis on mid-market payroll; decision: down-market or up?
say_en.note: Claude will scope and propose steps.

say_en.text: For deal defense: analyze rival product, reviews, positioning; make battle card.
say_en.note: Likely suggests product, customer, positioning steps.

say_en.text: Focus on competitor future moves: combine patents, hiring, earnings signals.
say_en.note: Triggers Step 6 and a threat assessment.
